description: Source code for bot management and AI behavior in the Unvanquished game, including bot creation, behavior setting, decision making, and navigation.

classes.name: botMemory_t
classes.description: Structure holding AI state and behavior information for a bot.

methods.name: BotBehaviorTree
methods.description: Reads and returns a behavior tree based on a behavior string.

methods.name: G_BotListTeamNames
methods.description: Lists bot names for a specific team.

methods.name: G_BotListNames
methods.description: Lists all bot names for both teams.

methods.name: G_BotClearNames
methods.description: Clears all bot names and usage flags.

methods.name: G_BotAddNames
methods.description: Adds new bot names to a team.

methods.name: G_BotSelectName
methods.description: Selects a random unused bot name from a team.

methods.name: G_BotNameUsed
methods.description: Marks a bot name as in use or free.

methods.name: G_BotSetSkill
methods.description: Sets the skill level for a bot.

methods.name: G_BotChangeBehavior
methods.description: Changes the behavior tree of a bot.

methods.name: G_BotSetBehavior
methods.description: Sets the behavior tree for a bot, resetting its state.

methods.name: G_BotSetDefaults
methods.description: Initializes default bot data and behavior.

methods.name: G_BotAdd
methods.description: Adds a new bot to the game with specified parameters.

methods.name: G_BotDel
methods.description: Removes a bot from the game.

methods.name: G_BotDelAllBots
methods.description: Removes all bots from the game.

methods.name: ShowRunningNode
methods.description: Displays the current running node of a bot's behavior tree.

methods.name: G_BotThink
methods.description: Main update function for bot AI each frame.

methods.name: G_BotSpectatorThink
methods.description: Update function for spectator bots.

methods.name: G_BotIntermissionThink
methods.description: Handles bot state during intermission.

methods.name: G_BotSelectSpawnClass
methods.description: Selects spawn class for a bot based on behavior tree.

methods.name: G_BotInit
methods.description: Initializes bot navigation and resources.

methods.name: G_BotCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up bot resources and removes all bots.

methods.name: G_BotCheckDefaultFill
methods.description: Checks and sets default team fill levels.

methods.name: G_BotFill
methods.description: Fills teams with bots to match target sizes.

methods.name: botMemory_t::willSprint
methods.description: Sets the desire to sprint for a bot.

methods.name: botMemory_t::doSprint
methods.description: Applies sprint decision based on stamina and desire.

methods.name: G_Bot_ResetBehaviorState
methods.description: Resets the behavior state of a bot.

methods.name: BotGoalToString
methods.description: Converts a bot's goal to a string representation.

methods.name: G_BotToString
methods.description: Returns a string describing a bot's current state.
